The '''Corellia Mining Corporation''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] organization founded during the early days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. This mining company discovered and colonized many worlds, the only known example being [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It also sold the [[CMC-A14 mining facility]] to governments and underworld organizations.
